description: This file defines the ReviewListController class within the OrangeHRM Performance module. The class extends ReviewSearchController and overrides the preRender method to initialize a Vue component named 'review-list' and set date-related properties.

classes.name: ReviewListController
classes.description: Controller class for handling review list views, extending the base ReviewSearchController, and setting up Vue component properties for rendering.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view by initializing the Vue component 'review-list' and setting date-related properties for the component.
